note: RI-MTH06 §C: the wave-1 RI-JRN01 blind pack recorded `reference-wins-on-review` partly
because the pack was unfair in FORM — our side was verbatim transcript from the running
build, the reference side was §A's recalled beat TABLE, which is narration. A pack in which
one side is dialogue and the other is stage direction is discriminable on register, not on
So this file is §A rows 3-12 re-expressed in the SAME four-field form beat-extract.mjs emits
for our side: actor, place, utterance, fields_set. It is committed once so that every future
critic compares against the same text, per RI-MTH06's How-we-lose #5.
`utterance` is what a person in the world SAYS or DOES at that beat. Where §A's table gives
narration rather than a line, the utterance is the recalled line if the item quotes one and
otherwise the action stated in the third person, which is the same treatment beat-extract
gives our own side's non-speech beats. Nothing here is invented beyond §A: every row's
content is traceable to the row of the same number.
DO NOT REGENERATE. This file is hand-authored from the corpus table and beat-extract.mjs
reads it; it will refuse to overwrite it.
